prompt: Make a single exquisite complete landscape illustration, aspect ratio 3:2, for an artist's handmade personal website, no type or lettering anywhere. It is a richly illustrated cozy stationery still life, an overhead view of a well-used teal-green painted wooden writing desk at late afternoon. Gouache and colored pencil on warm textured paper, gently misregistered old screen-print inks, cut-paper shadows, soft broken color, the kind of distinctive illustration you would keep as a print. Warm ochre, plum ink, faded dusty rose, cream, celadon, dark pine. Composition must work as an interactive illustrated map: FOUR big, distinct, visually separate, easy-to-identify objects roughly arranged in four quadrants, each complete with clear silhouette and breathing room, and all four in a single continuous scene. TOP LEFT centered around 27% x, 27% y: a cutely chunky small pale seafoam analog oscilloscope with dark green glass and a single pale yellow oscillating trace on the screen, a couple of physical knobs and a coiled lead, conveying experiments. TOP RIGHT at 72% x, 25% y: a small pile of lipstick-pink and lavender air mail envelopes, a little star-shaped postage stamp, embossed seal, no legible addresses. BOTTOM LEFT at 27% x, 70% y: a handsome amber/peach oak library card FILE BOX, open top with raised index cards in muted mustard, pink and mint with blank tabs, brass front holder, foreshortened slightly to see the real contents. BOTTOM RIGHT at 70% x, 70% y: a dog-eared plum and muted blue clothbound personal notebook, closed, with embroidered tiny cream calico cat sleeping on its cover, an elastic band and red ribbon bookmark, little paper slips poking out. Small peripheral human touches only out at the edges (a sharpened pencil, a barely cropped tea saucer, crumbs from a star cookie, a small calico cat paw entering from far right). A window casts a gentle golden diagonal patch of light on the desk. Closely framed yet composed, no humans, no typography, no letters, no numbers, no drawn labels, no interface, no text bubbles, no graphic frames. Make it a place a real person could sit, intimate and idiosyncratic; avoid tidy isometric vector rendering or glossy 3D. The four hero objects should be large, readable even as a small thumbnail. Visible tabletop separates the quadrants. No additional prominent objects.
